description: Use this when the user gives a recipient (or sender) postal address in Spain, before creating a burofax, to catch mistakes that would stop delivery. Checks offline: required fields (name, street, postcode, city), the 5-digit código postal in range 01000–52999, and that the province matches the postcode's first two digits. Returns normalised fields (with the official province) and a list of problems with messages for the user. It does not confirm that the street or person exists. Do not use for addresses outside Spain.

name.description: Recipient's full name or company name.

province.description: Province, if the user gave one.

name: check_spanish_address
title: Check a Spanish postal address
